提出単位: `F03-F04`（1 branch，1 PR，1学習ログ）

## 目的

[F04授業](../lessons/F04.qmd)で学んだ三つの一次元差分を実装し，一次元の観測次数とF03の四公式の格子収束を確認して，[F03課題](F03.qmd)から続く一つの提出を完成させます．
branch，テスト，学習ログ，PR，mergeの共通手順は[学生向け課題ワークフロー](../guides/workflow.qmd)を参照してください．

## 学生リポジトリ内の場所

- 解析関数: [`exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl)
- 実装・実行: [`exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl)
- 配布済み必須テスト・自作テスト: [`exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/tests.jl`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/tests.jl)
- 学習ログ: `exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/learning_log.md`

## 開始または再開

第4回に作成した`F03-F04`用branchへ戻って作業を続けてください．
まだ開始していない場合は，[F03の開始手順](F03.qmd#開始)を参照してください．

## 実装範囲

学生が実装するのは次の3関数だけです．

- [`forward_difference(f, x, h)`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L37-L41)
- [`backward_difference(f, x, h)`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L43-L47)
- [`centered_difference(f, x, h)`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L49-L53)

[`centered_partial`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L87-L96)，[`curl_gradient_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L99-L110)，[`divergence_curl_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L113-L116)，[`product_divergence_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L119-L125)，[`curl_curl_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L128-L138)，[`verify_vector_identities`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L141-L163)，解析関数，格子走査，残差集計は提供済みです．

[授業の四つの数値残差](../lessons/F04.qmd#四公式の数値残差)は，次の関数に対応します．

| 残差 | 提供済み関数 | 場・比較対象の解析関数 |
|---|---|---|
| $\boldsymbol{r}_1$ | [`curl_gradient_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L99-L110) | [`gradient_scalar`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L22-L28) |
| $r_2$ | [`divergence_curl_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L113-L116) | [`curl_vector`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L31-L38) |
| $r_3$ | [`product_divergence_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L119-L125) | [`scalar_field`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L6)，[`vector_field`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L8-L12)，[`gradient_scalar`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L22-L28)，[`divergence_vector`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L45-L48) |
| $\boldsymbol{r}_4$ | [`curl_curl_residual`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L128-L138) | [`curl_vector`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L31-L38)，[`gradient_divergence_vector`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L50-L53)，[`laplacian_vector`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/F03.jl#L55-L58) |

[`centered_partial`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L87-L96)は自分の[`centered_difference`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L49-L53)を三次元座標へ接続し，[`verify_vector_identities`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L141-L163)が内部格子点で最大残差を集計します．

## 一次元収束

[授業の標準条件](../lessons/F04.qmd#problem-setup)で一次元収束を計算します．
[`convergence_study`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L55-L79)で前進・後退の誤差比が`1.7`から`2.3`，中心差分の誤差比が`3.7`から`4.3`に入ることを確認し，観測次数も説明してください．

## ベクトル解析四公式

[`verify_vector_identities(9)`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L141-L163)と[`verify_vector_identities(17)`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl#L141-L163)を実行します．
四つの最大残差がすべて減少し，各粗格子／細格子比が`3.0`から`4.8`に入ることを確認します．
数値残差の定義と，内側・外側の微分の扱いは[授業](../lessons/F04.qmd#四公式の数値残差)を参照してください．

## 実行とテスト

[`run.jl`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/run.jl)の実行と[`exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/tests.jl`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/tests.jl)の配布済み必須テストは，[学生向け課題ワークフローの「通常の課題作業」](../guides/workflow.qmd#exercise-work)と[「テスト」](../guides/workflow.qmd#tests)に従ってください．

- 二次関数の手計算値で三つの差分を区別できる．
- 刻み幅を半分にした誤差から，各差分の収束次数を確かめられる．

各期待値と判定範囲を確認した後，別の関数・評価点・入力条件から一つ選び，同じファイルの自作TODOへテストを書いてください．
検出する実装ミスも説明します．

{{< include /assignments/_understanding-check.qmd >}}

F03とF04は別々のチェックです．
[F03のチェック](F03.qmd#understanding-check)が未提出なら，そちらも完了してください．
コードは一つのPRで提出しますが，対話ログは`understanding-check-F03.txt`と`understanding-check-F04.txt`に分け，それぞれ対応するLETUS課題へ提出します．

## 学習ログ

`exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/learning_log.md`に，共通の記録項目に加えて次をまとめてください．

- 四つの成分証明と，混合偏微分を交換する条件
- 一次元誤差と観測次数
- `n=9`と`n=17`の四残差と比
- 解析的証明と数値的証拠の役割の違い

解釈は[授業の「証明と数値的証拠」](../lessons/F04.qmd#証明と数値的証拠)と照合してください．

- `n=9`と`n=17`で四残差が減少し，各比が`3.0`から`4.8`に入ることを確認した．
- [`exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/tests.jl`](https://github.com/t2lab-it/thermofluid-exercise-student-2026/blob/main/exercises/F03-F04_vector_calculus/tests.jl)の配布済み必須テストを確認し，一つの自作TODOを完成して全テストを通した．
